VI.description: Opens a new instance of RemoteVI Server Loop.vi\2C found next to this VI (both live in source\5CServer)\3A the Server Loop is reentrant (preallocated clone)\2C and Open VI Reference with option 0x08 (prepare for reentrant run) returns a reference to a clone of its own\2C so every share of this LabVIEW application instance runs its own loop. Nothing is opened on an incoming error.

Node.inputs: base path:dir.stripped path,name or relative path:svi.value
vi path:spath.appended path,options:opt.value,error in (no error):me.error out

error in or an error opening the Server Loop.
